gap.author_gap: Biomedical AI agents rely on manually curated, static toolsets and cannot keep pace with the field; a self-evolving agent should discover tools and update its knowledge from experience.
gap.checked_gap: The static-toolset limitation is plausible but asserted with citations only; the paper does not show that tool coverage limits the baselines (no tool-set ablation or failure attribution), and general self-evolving-agent neighbors (skill/tool libraries, experience memories) are not discussed.
lineage: static biomedical agents: Biomni, OriGene and others (refs 7-14)

gap.residue: Whether new tools or templates, rather than extra attempts and a stronger multi-agent backbone, produce the gains is untested.

gap.method_response: Four-agent system with Template Library and Tool Creation Agent.
gap.remaining_gap: No retention rule, ablation, held-out split or cost accounting.

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: Executable artifacts crossing agent boundaries and a Tool Creation Agent growing the action space map onto forging tools when a capability gap appears.
pattern_mapping.conditions_differences: RS card requires verification closure and ablation of the verified step; domain card requires execution-gated admission and abstraction validation. Neither is described or ablated in this paper.

claims.text: STELLA achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on HLE-Biomedicine (about 26%), LAB-Bench DBQA (about 54%) and LitQA (about 63%).
claims.setting: 50 HLE questions; 12.5% subsets of LAB-Bench; Claude 4 Sonnet + Gemini 2.5 Pro agents
claims.baseline_control: Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude 4 Opus, DeepSeek-R1, o3, Biomni
claims.selection_vs_test: no development set; trials on scored items
claims.result_denominator: 50 questions on HLE; subset sizes not stated; 3 runs
claims.allowed_conclusion: Task-level scores on small benchmark subsets exceed those of the listed single-pass models under the authors protocol.

claims.text: Performance systematically improves with experience (HLE-Bio 14% to 26%), evidencing self-evolution.
claims.allowed_conclusion: Accuracy rises with number of trials; attribution to retained templates or tools is not established.

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: A multi-agent biomedical agent scores higher than listed single-pass LLMs on small benchmark subsets when given multiple trials; no evidence isolates a retained template or tool effect.
unresolved: What carries across trials and what feedback decides it

G.reason: Real but generic limitation (static curated toolsets) with an agent baseline, yet no demonstration that tool coverage binds, and general self-evolving-agent neighbors are not discussed.

M.reason: Narrative mechanism (templates from successes, tool-creation for gaps) with plausible fit, but the assumptions that templates are selected well and created tools are valid carry the claim and are unexplained.

X.reason: Agent roles are named, but admission, selection, storage, versioning, retrieval of templates, tool testing and rollback are not described in the text; key conditions cannot be reconstructed.

E.measurement.reason: Standard benchmark accuracies, but tiny subsets (50 questions), unspecified answer scoring and trial aggregation, and inconsistent headline margins (6 vs 8 points).

E.causality.reason: Only a trials-vs-accuracy curve; no template/tool ablation, no equal-trial or equal-backbone baseline, so retry or best-of-n effects are not excluded.

E.holdout.reason: No development split; evolution and scoring occur on the same questions, and whether correctness feedback drives storage is not stated.

E.statistics.reason: Sample sizes partly given (50 HLE questions) and three runs averaged, but no spread, intervals or tests; with 2-point question granularity the 14 to 26 move is 6 questions.

E.cost.reason: Budget expressed as trial multiples up to 9x; baselines get a single pass; no token, call or tool-creation cost.

rationale: Short preprint asserting self-evolving templates and tools; evidence is a trial-scaling curve on small subsets with no ablation, holdout, variance or cost, and the retention mechanism is not specified.
